source: Wright 2015 (PMID 24456384) abstract: '41 received the active Yakult (12.2% diarrhoea) and 46 received placebo (8.7% diarrhoea).' Per-arm AAD counts derived by percentage-corroboration from the stated percentages and arm denominators (each is the UNIQUE integer consistent with the printed percent): 5 of 41 = 12.195% (rounds to 12.2%; 4/41=9.8%, 6/41=14.6% do not) probiotic, 4 of 46 = 8.696% (rounds to 8.7%; 3/46=6.5%, 5/46=10.9% do not) placebo. Double-blind RCT (ACTRN12609000429257), L. casei Shirota vs placebo, geriatric inpatients; standard AAD outcome. Abstract path had declared it absent because the counts are given only as percentages, not as 'X of Y'.
